parsed.why: No trans-specific offence; courts, third-gender documents and education protect. But 2024 provincial reports of physical/sexual harassment, discrimination in public institutions and 2026 state-adjacent hate speech keep it mid-band.

Same-sex conduct read down in 2024, but no identity/expression protection and police documented dismissing anti-LGBT violence. Trans-specific position undocumented; structural signals give only moderate safety.

Sodomy statute enforced sporadically; police a main source of rape and beating of trans people, abuse continuing when reported amid broad impunity. Cultural third-gender havens are social facts, not protection.

Facilities access protected, GI hate-crime aggravation operating, high acceptance, no trans criminalisation. Pending roll-back bills and ombudsman challenge are unresolved political risk, not yet law.

Public same-sex affection criminalised; local organisation documents false-accusation arrests and police torture of LGBTQ people, with entrenched concealment, no gender recognition and no anti-discrimination recourse.
